bounded_statement: The selected result claims an occurrence rate for the entire 96-station scheduled network but divides the 18 observed occurrences by only the 72 stations retained after screening.

counterevidence_considered.description: The numerator and denominator do form an internally coherent retained-subset rate because the report identifies all 18 occurrences as observed among retained stations; this would falsify the issue if the target and claim were also subset-conditional.

evidence.description: The generating workflow directly constructs the selected result with SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS as the denominator.

SELECTED_LINE = f'[selected-result] Occurrence rate for the entire scheduled survey network: {OBSERVED_OCCURRENCES} occurrences divided by {SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS} retained stations = {SELECTED_RATE_FRACTION} ({SELECTED_RATE_PERCENT} occurrences per 100 stations).' + LF

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the mismatch by checking whether the scientific target or selected claim was explicitly conditional on passing the screen. The retained-subset accounting supports 18/72 as a conditional rate, but task.md line 1 and results/report.md lines 4 and 15 instead specify the entire scheduled network, so the attempt failed.

root_cause: The workflow assigns SCREEN_PASSED_STATIONS, rather than SCHEDULED_STATIONS, as the selected result's exposure denominator while labeling the result as applying to the entire scheduled network.
